Diagnostics.//LogSensitiveData: Writes SQL parameter values into the logs. Those values are patient names, addresses, telephone numbers and signatures, which §3 of the constitution forbids in logs — so this stays false in every file that is committed. Turn it on for a diagnosis, on your own machine, against a database whose contents you are willing to read in a log, and turn it off afterwards. It is a key of its own, and not the environment being called Development, because the Azure environment is called Development too and holds real patients.
